overview:
**Fire danger is Moderate today, driven by elevated energy release component (60%) and burning index (54%) despite mild temperatures and light winds.**
- Danger dips to Low on Thursday (Oct 22) as a wetting system moves through, then returns to Moderate for the rest of the week.
- A disturbance brings Wednesday's main weather shift: scattered showers and possible thunderstorms with a 60% chance of precipitation and a high near 62.
- No Red Flag Warning is in effect, and 0 of 7 local watchout thresholds are currently met.
- No fire restrictions are active in Montrose, Delta, Gunnison, Ouray, or San Miguel counties, or on GMUG National Forest and BLM lands — all were lifted earlier this fall.
- No active wildfires are burning in or near this area; the only uncontained large fire in the national report is in Wyoming, well outside this zone.
